assembly_instructions: 1. Bolt the base_frame to the floor and fasten the input_plate, embedding_table, MoE service deck, optimizer rail, operations rail, and KV cache pedestal to it. 2. Install the two tower service rails, four mHC residual rails, bottom crossmembers, top crossmembers, and diagonal braces to form an open decoder cage with no opaque enclosure. 3. Slide the visible layer plates onto the cage in order: block_01_hca, block_02_hca, block_03_csa, block_04_hca, block_05_csa, block_06_hca, block_07_csa, block_08_hca, the alternating elided CSA/HCA tick plates, block_60_csa, and block_61_hca. 4. Mount the CSA exploded pipeline on the right-front spine in order: RMSNorm, query projection, compressed KV projection, lightning indexer, top-k selector, gather fan, sparse attention core, and grouped output projection. 5. Mount the HCA exploded lane on the left-front spine with the 128x compressor feeding the dense compressed core and then returning to the HCA plates. 6. Install the heterogeneous KV cache column on the left rear service rail, placing the BF16/FP8 disk at the base and the 128-token sliding-window buffer at the top. 7. Assemble the MoE deck by placing the FP4 plate, grouped-GEMM tray, shared expert, dispatch ring, top-6 router, six routed expert cartridges, SwiGLU clamp, and anticipatory routing marker in that order. 8. Fit the prediction head, MTP module, LM loss marker, and MTP loss marker above the final plate. 9. Mount the optimizer blocks and parameter routes on the far-left rail. 10. Attach the decomposed operations plates on the far-right rail as TP, EP, PP, and DP plates, then add checkpointing and training-data plates so each operational subsystem is grounded and connected.

info.summary: 1.6T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model (49B activated per token) with a hybrid Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) + Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) backbone, manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC), Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), Muon optimiser, and FP4/FP8/BF16 mixed precision, natively supporting 1M-token context.
info.description: This scene treats the model as a buildable open-frame machine: tokens enter at the floor, climb a four-rail mHC residual tower through 61 transformer layers, branch into visible CSA/HCA attention machinery, pass through a decomposed MoE expert bank, and leave through tied prediction and MTP heads. Important internals are exposed as adjacent exploded subassemblies rather than hidden inside opaque blocks.

parts.name: Grounded Assembly Base Frame
parts.role: Rigid base rail that roots the token path, decoder tower, KV column, optimizer rail, MoE deck, and operations rail on the ground plane.

parts.name: Input Tokens Plate
parts.role: Ground-level token-ID tray where packed BPE tokens enter the model before embedding lookup.

parts.name: Embedding Table
parts.role: V=128K by d=7168 lookup slab that converts token IDs into BF16 residual vectors and is trained by AdamW.
parts.memory_footprint: 128000 x 7168 x 2 bytes is about 1.83 GiB

parts.name: Left Tower Service Rail
parts.role: Structural side rail that carries layer plates and exposes the vertical 61-layer build order.

parts.name: Right Tower Service Rail
parts.role: Structural side rail that supports the CSA exploded service branch and the layer stack.

parts.name: Decoder Tower Bottom Crossmember
parts.role: Lower brace tying the service rails together above the embedding table before the first transformer plate.

parts.name: Decoder Tower Top Crossmember
parts.role: Top brace tying the four residual rails together above the final transformer block.

parts.name: Front Decoder Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Slender diagonal brace on the open front face that stabilizes the decoder cage without hiding the plates.

parts.name: Rear Decoder Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Slender rear brace that makes the tower mechanically buildable while leaving the front cutaway unobstructed.

parts.name: mHC Residual Rail Front Left
parts.role: One of four exposed manifold-constrained hyper-connection channels carrying residual state through every block.

parts.name: mHC Residual Rail Front Right
parts.role: Second exposed mHC channel showing the n_hc=4 residual expansion instead of a single hidden stream.

parts.name: mHC Residual Rail Back Left
parts.role: Third mHC channel making the four-stream residual carrier visible from side and top views.

parts.name: mHC Residual Rail Back Right
parts.role: Fourth mHC channel that completes the n_hc=4 residual cage around the transformer plates.

parts.name: Sinkhorn-Knopp Projector
parts.role: Small ring marker for the 20-iteration row and column normalization that projects each mHC mixing matrix onto the Birkhoff polytope.

parts.name: Block 1 HCA Plate
parts.role: First HCA-only transformer plate using m'=128 compressed dense attention before the CSA/HCA alternation begins.

parts.name: Block 2 HCA Plate
parts.role: Second HCA-only transformer plate and one of the early hash-routed MoE layers.

parts.name: Block 3 CSA Plate
parts.role: First CSA transformer plate with m=4 compression and top-k=1024 sparse retrieval, mirrored by the exploded CSA pipeline at the right.

parts.name: Block 4 HCA Plate
parts.role: Interleaved HCA plate that performs dense attention over a 128-times-compressed representation.

parts.name: Block 5 CSA Plate
parts.role: Representative CSA plate in the alternating region, connected to the same sparse attention machinery as block 3.

parts.name: Block 6 HCA Plate
parts.role: Representative HCA plate in the alternating region, keeping the compressed dense attention path visible.

parts.name: Block 7 CSA Plate
parts.role: Mid-stack CSA plate showing that the sparse compressed attention pattern repeats through depth.

parts.name: Block 8 HCA Plate
parts.role: Upper representative HCA plate before the elided alternating depth markers.

parts.name: Elided CSA Tick Blocks 9-18
parts.role: Thin rear tick plate indicating a group of omitted CSA layers without occluding the front cutaway.

parts.name: Elided HCA Tick Blocks 19-28
parts.role: Thin rear tick plate indicating omitted HCA layers and preserving the alternating CSA/HCA pattern.

parts.name: Elided CSA Tick Blocks 29-38
parts.role: Second CSA depth tick showing that sparse compressed attention continues through the omitted middle depth.

parts.name: Elided HCA Tick Blocks 39-48
parts.role: Second HCA depth tick showing that dense compressed attention repeats in the omitted middle depth.

parts.name: Elided CSA Tick Blocks 49-59
parts.role: Final elided CSA tick that connects the omitted depth back into the rendered top CSA block.

parts.name: Block 60 CSA Plate
parts.role: Penultimate rendered CSA plate showing the sparse path persists to the top of the model.

parts.name: Block 61 HCA Final Plate
parts.role: Final HCA transformer plate feeding the tied prediction head.

parts.name: CSA Sparse Lane Marker
parts.role: Small front marker showing CSA plates route to the sparse retrieval service lane rather than the HCA dense lane.

parts.name: HCA Dense Lane Marker
parts.role: Small front marker showing early HCA plates route to the 128x dense compressed attention lane.

parts.name: CSA Exploded Pipeline Spine
parts.role: Vertical service spine that holds the exploded CSA internals in assembly order next to block 3.

parts.name: CSA Pre-RMSNorm Tile
parts.role: RMSNorm tile that normalizes the residual stream before the CSA projections.

parts.name: CSA Query Down and Up Projection
parts.role: Two-stage query projection from d=7168 to d_c=1536 and back into 128 attention heads.

parts.name: CSA Compressed KV Projector
parts.role: KV compression tile that packs each group of four tokens into one compressed cache entry.

parts.name: CSA Lightning Indexer
parts.role: FP4 indexer tile with 64 query heads that scores all compressed KV entries for sparse retrieval.

parts.name: CSA Top-k Selector
parts.role: Selector tile that chooses the 1024 highest-scoring compressed KV entries and builds the sparse gather index.

parts.name: CSA Sparse Gather Fan
parts.role: Ring marker showing that top-k indices fan out into a sparse gather before attention is evaluated.

parts.name: CSA Sparse Attention Core
parts.role: FlashAttention-style core attending over the 1024 selected compressed entries plus the 128-token sliding window.

parts.name: CSA Grouped Output Projection
parts.role: Grouped output projection tile that maps attention heads back into the model dimension using g=16 groups.

parts.name: Shared Lightning Indexer Marker
parts.role: Small marker on the tower face showing that each CSA plate owns the same FP4 indexer path exposed in the exploded pipeline.

parts.name: Attention Sink Logit Marker
parts.role: Per-head learnable sink logit that allows uninformative tokens to contribute less than a probability mass of one.

parts.name: HCA 128x Compressor
parts.role: HCA side module that compresses the attention view by m'=128 before dense compressed attention.

parts.name: HCA Dense Compressed Core
parts.role: Dense attention core over heavily compressed entries, kept external so the HCA path is not hidden in the layer plates.

parts.name: HCA Return Manifold
parts.role: Short horizontal manifold returning the HCA dense-compressed result into the mHC residual cage.

parts.name: Heterogeneous KV Cache Column
parts.role: External cache reservoir holding CSA m=4 entries and HCA m'=128 entries so long-context memory is visible outside the tower.
parts.memory_footprint: about 70 KB per layer per token equivalent for CSA-compressed decode

parts.name: KV BF16 plus FP8 Precision Disk
parts.role: Base disk marking the mixed KV format with BF16 RoPE dimensions and FP8 non-RoPE dimensions.

parts.name: CSA m=4 KV Tap
parts.role: Side tap marking the denser CSA compressed-cache stream that stores one KV entry per four tokens.

parts.name: HCA m'=128 KV Tap
parts.role: Side tap marking the heavily compressed HCA stream that stores one dense-attention entry per 128 tokens.

parts.name: Sliding-Window KV Buffer
parts.role: Small top buffer holding the most recent 128 tokens at full resolution for local attention.

parts.name: MoE Service Deck
parts.role: Grounded deck that supports the router, active experts, shared expert, communication ring, and quantisation plate.

parts.name: Top-6 Router
parts.role: Router disk computing Sqrt(Softplus) affinities and selecting six routed experts from 384 choices.

parts.name: Expert All-to-All Dispatch Ring
parts.role: Communication ring representing NCCL all-to-all dispatch and combine around expert-parallel ranks.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 1
parts.role: One visible cartridge from the top-6 routed expert set, standing for a SwiGLU FFN with intermediate dimension 3072.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 2
parts.role: Second visible routed expert cartridge showing that six experts are executed per token.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 3
parts.role: Third routed expert cartridge receiving a token shard after the all-to-all dispatch.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 4
parts.role: Fourth routed expert cartridge making top-6 activation explicit rather than a single opaque expert bank.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 5
parts.role: Fifth routed expert cartridge contributing a weighted FFN result to the combined output.

parts.name: Active Routed Expert 6
parts.role: Sixth routed expert cartridge completing the per-token top-6 MoE activation set.

parts.name: Shared Always-On Expert
parts.role: Always-on shared expert that runs for every token and stabilizes the routed expert mixture.

parts.name: Grouped Expert GEMM Tray
parts.role: Fused grouped-GEMM tray that batches the active expert FFNs into one high-utilization kernel.

parts.name: FP4 Expert Quantisation Plate
parts.role: Quantisation plate directly under the routed experts showing that expert weights and indexer QK paths use FP4-aware training.

parts.name: Hash Router for First Three MoE Layers
parts.role: Fixed hash-routing block for the first three MoE layers before learned routing becomes stable.

parts.name: SwiGLU Clamp Marker
parts.role: Activation clamp marker that limits expert SwiGLU outliers to protect FP4 and FP8 arithmetic.

parts.name: Anticipatory Routing Snapshot
parts.role: Small snapshot marker showing that stale router parameters can be used during loss-spike recovery.

parts.name: Tied LM Prediction Head
parts.role: Tied vocabulary projection head mapping final hidden states back to 128K logits.

parts.name: MTP Depth-1 Auxiliary Head
parts.role: Single multi-token-prediction module that trains an auxiliary next-step head and enables speculative decoding.

parts.name: Cross-Entropy Loss Marker
parts.role: Primary next-token cross-entropy objective marker connected to the prediction head.

parts.name: MTP Loss Marker
parts.role: Auxiliary MTP loss marker whose weight decays from 0.3 to 0.1 during late training.

parts.name: Optimizer Maintenance Rail
parts.role: Far-left support rail carrying the two optimizer blocks and their parameter routing plates.

parts.name: Muon Optimizer Block
parts.role: Optimizer block for matrix-shaped parameters using Newton-Schulz orthonormalized updates.

parts.name: AdamW Optimizer Block
parts.role: Optimizer block for embeddings, prediction head, RMSNorm weights, mHC scalars, and other sensitive small tensors.

parts.name: Parameter Route to Muon
parts.role: Thin plate marking attention, FFN, and expert matrices as routed to Muon.

parts.name: Parameter Route to AdamW
parts.role: Thin plate marking embeddings, heads, norms, router bias, and mHC scalars as routed to AdamW.

parts.name: Operations Rail
parts.role: Right-side rail mounting training operations, parallelism, checkpointing, and data curriculum markers.

parts.name: Tensor Parallelism Plate
parts.role: Tensor-parallel plate connected to attention and GEMM blocks that split large matrix multiplications across devices.

parts.name: Expert Parallelism Plate
parts.role: Expert-parallel plate connected to the router and dispatch ring that distributes routed experts across ranks.

parts.name: Pipeline Parallelism Plate
parts.role: Pipeline-parallel plate connected to the decoder tower depth to show layer groups staged across workers.

parts.name: Data Parallelism Plate
parts.role: Data-parallel plate connected to the training data pipe and optimizer rail for replicated batch shards.

parts.name: Selective Activation Checkpointing Plate
parts.role: Memory-control plate showing that expensive activations are recomputed during backward to fit long-context training.

parts.name: 33T Token Training Data Pipe
parts.role: Data curriculum plate for 33T training tokens and sequence-length warmup from 4K to 1M context.
